## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Manual verification completed where applicable.

## Screenshots of working functionality

Every PR must include visual proof of the changed functionality. Attach real screenshots directly to this PR description or link the CI screenshot artifact. Use working app states and actual results, not mockups.

- [ ] Screenshots show the implemented behavior and final result.
- [ ] The CI `dbux-pr-ui-screenshots` artifact is available or screenshots are attached here.
- [ ] For non-visual changes, explain why screenshots are not applicable and include relevant test/output evidence.

## Notes / limitations

Document follow-ups, trade-offs, and known limitations.
